title: Mistune: Quadratic-time DoS in inline image parsing (precedence_scan) bypasses not-is-image guards (CVE-2026-97699)
description: Mistune versions prior to 3.3.4 contain a quadratic-time denial-of-service vulnerability in the inline image parsing logic. The vulnerability arises because certain guards intended to limit processing time are bypassed for image syntax, causing excessive CPU usage when parsing crafted markdown input with repeated image openers. This can cause a single unauthenticated request to consume 100% CPU on a worker, significantly degrading service availability. The issue is fixed in version 3.3.4.
